description: Website live gripper preview: mix and match parts. Make the gripper (fingers, 1.x line) and the handles (strap-loop attachment, 2.x line) separate selectable parts in the preview, so any gripper version can be combined with any handle version and shown assembled together. Default view on load is 2.1; 1.1 must also be selectable. See AGENTS.md for the versioning scheme (1.x gripper only, 2.x gripper plus handles). Related: voice-4c63021e (2.1) and voice-caae8e01 (preview bug), both in human/.
summary: The live gripper preview locks the 1.x gripper and 2.x strap-loop handles together as one version. Let users pick gripper and handle versions separately, showing the combination assembled, with 2.1 as default and 1.1 selectable.
